preregistration_note: Seongchan bundle: learned-weight CAI + equal-weight comparison (blocked until an eligible component exists; single component => weight learning not forced).

target.definition: label = 1 when Close[t+5] > Close[t], else 0; trading days are the confirmed CL=F daily array inside the in-sample window

components_note: No eligible CAI component yet: LAUE (BLS terms page 403, publication timing unverified) and TMAS (2 monthly samples only) are not modeling inputs. CAI models must stay blocked until a component with a usage/availability basis is pinned here.

quality.note: Added 2026-09-11 before any model result was produced (validation caught the 2020-04-20 negative WTI settlement). Non-positive closes are excluded as missing observations; labels whose forward window includes one are dropped; never filled or floored.

decision_rules.primary_metric: log_loss on the shared validation index (2021-01-01..2023-12-31)
decision_rules.comparison: same eval dates, same target, same common inputs; deltas vs baseline_up_rate
decision_rules.selection: no model is selected for production from this dev run; final OOS stays locked
decision_rules.single_component_rule: learned CAI weights are not forced when only one component exists; that case is reported as a single-component baseline, never as a synthetic CAI

notes: Real inputs only: WTI CL=F daily from the repo's fixed price source. Out-of-sample 2024+ is never read by the runner.
